details:
Q1: Which area of the repository should this issue change?
Choices:
A) The review/autofix pipeline (`review_autofix.yml`, reviewer, consolidator or editor scripts)
B) The orchestrator, its poller or its judges (`orchestrate*.yml`, `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh`)
C) The clarify, plan or implement phase workflows and their prompts
D) Documentation only (`README.md`, `agents.md`, `docs/`)
E) Something else: please name the file, workflow or feature (RECOMMENDED)
Q2: What does "better" mean for that area?
Choices:
A) Fix a specific bug or failure: please link the failing run, issue or PR, or describe the symptom (RECOMMENDED)
B) Lower cost or run time: please name the metric and target
C) Add a new capability: please describe the behaviour you expect
D) Make docs or operator messages clearer: please say which text is confusing
Q3: How will we know the change is done?
Choices:
A) A specific observable outcome, such as a test passing, a log line appearing or a failure no longer happening; please state it (RECOMMENDED)
B) A measurable threshold, such as N% fewer API calls or runs under X minutes; please state it
C) No formal criteria; the implementer decides (this has a high risk of changes nobody wanted)
